findings.message: Patient testimonial with none on file (FTC 16 CFR 465 risk).

findings.evidence: author.name: schema='Dr. Elena Marsh' vs post='Dr. Marcus Oyelaran'
findings.message: JSON-LD 'author.name' does not match the post.

findings.quote: "I was nervous about whitening, but my teeth are four shades brighter and I had no sensitivity at all," says Maria T., a recent patient.
findings.why: The ficha lists no testimonials on file, so this quote is unverifiable and likely fabricated, and it also makes a specific result claim (four shades, no sensitivity) with no typicality disclosure under the FTC Endorsement Guides.
findings.fix: Delete the testimonial and the specific results claim; if a real, documented testimonial is later obtained, include written consent and a clear 'results not typical' disclosure.

findings.why: The JSON-LD names Dr. Elena Marsh as author while the visible byline says author is Dr. Marcus Oyelaran and Dr. Marsh is only the reviewer.
findings.fix: Change the JSON-LD author to Dr. Marcus Oyelaran and, if desired, add Dr. Marsh as reviewedBy.

findings.quote: Whitening products use a peroxide-based gel to break up stains inside and on the surface of the tooth.
findings.why: The mechanism is broadly consistent with ADA guidance, but it is a checkable claim not tied to a specific source beyond the general MouthHealthy link.
findings.fix: Optionally cite the ADA MouthHealthy page directly at this sentence.

findings.quote: The ADA's [MouthHealthy page on teeth whitening](https://www.mouthhealthy.org/all-topics-a-z/teeth-whitening) covers the basics.
findings.why: I cannot verify that this exact URL exists or resolves, although MouthHealthy is a real ADA site and a whitening topic page plausibly exists.
findings.fix: Open the link before publishing and confirm it loads and covers whitening; replace it with the correct URL if not.

findings.quote: Pregnancy or breastfeeding, where many dentists advise waiting.
findings.why: Elective whitening is commonly deferred during pregnancy and breastfeeding because safety data are limited, but no source is given.
findings.fix: Add a reputable source or phrase it as 'safety data are limited, so ask your dentist'.

findings.quote: Whitening is safe for most healthy mouths when done correctly.
findings.why: A blanket safety assurance in the meta description is stronger than the body text, which says 'generally considered safe', and it has no cited support.
findings.fix: Align the description with the body's hedged wording and tie it to the ADA source.

findings.quote: At-home kits are cheaper and slower, and results depend on how consistently you use them.
findings.why: General comparison with no source, and 'cheaper and slower' is not true for every product.
findings.fix: Soften to 'often cheaper and slower' or add a source.

findings.quote: Bluebonnet Hollow Dental is a fictional practice created for a software demonstration. This post is sample content.
findings.why: The demo disclaimer is appropriate for this fictional clinic but must not appear on a real published page, and it contradicts the promotional 'Visit us' call to action.
findings.fix: Keep it only in the demo context and remove it if the post ever goes live for a real practice.
